messages:
Maria: Hey — quick q: we started seeing ArgoCD start syncing app changes before Atlantis finishes applying infra in a couple PR merges. Any recommended guard?
Sam: Ugh. Is ArgoCD watching the repo directly and triggering on the merge commit?
Maria: Yep. GH Actions merges -> ArgoCD webhook -> sync. Atlantis apply runs via workflow after the merge (we call atlantis apply in CI). Sometimes infra not ready and app deploy fails.
Lee: Two main patterns: 1) make ArgoCD wait for a signal that apply succeeded; 2) ensure apply runs before merge (protected merges). Both have tradeoffs.
Nate: We can't block merge on apply for product teams. So prefer post-merge gating.
Priya: We've used a tiny lock file approach before: CI writes a key to S3 when apply done, and ArgoCD pre-sync hook checks the S3 key and waits/requeues. Works cross-team.
ci-bot: Example GH Action step (simple):
```
jobs:
  apply:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: run atlantis apply
        run: atlantis apply -d infra
      - name: mark applied
        run: aws s3 cp /dev/null s3://infra-locks/${{ github.sha }} --acl private
```

ops-bot: Alternative is to use a commit tag/branch update: apply job pushes a small commit that updates a file `infra/last_applied.txt` to the merge SHA. ArgoCD only syncs when that file matches HEAD.
Sam: If using ArgoCD you can add a `preSync` resource hook (a Job) that queries your state store and exits non-zero until key exists. ArgoCD will retry per its sync retry policy.
Lee: Also consider GH Actions concurrency + ordering so apply job starts earlier: `needs: [plan]` and make `merge` wait for `apply` using API — but that needs protected branch automation.
Maria: Which is lower ops to implement quickly? Lock-file in S3 vs commit update vs preSync hook?
Priya: S3 lock is fastest. Small infra and IAM needed. commit update needs repo write perms and can be noisy.
Nate: If we do S3 approach, add TTL so failed applies don't block forever.
Sam: +1. Also add a short backoff loop in the preSync job: check up to X mins then fail with clear message.
Maria: OK let's try S3 lock + ArgoCD preSync job. Can someone draft the preSync script? 
Lee: I'll do a quick PoC: bash script that polls `aws s3 ls s3://infra-locks/${GITHUB_SHA}` and exit 0 when exists else sleep. Will push in a k8s job manifest.
Priya: I'll update GH Action to copy the empty object. I'll add TTL cleanup (lifecycle rule or a GC Lambda).
Maria: Awesome. Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short doc + link to the PoC PR.
ops-bot: Reminder: update runbooks after rollout :memo:
Sam: Also add metric/alert for repeated ArgoCD preSync failures so we notice.
